marks.note: The records were offered by someone with no authority to release them. Reading them would have made every later paragraph unpublishable, and describing them second-hand would have been worse.

notes.text: the farebox data it does not publish
notes.label: Unpublished series
notes.body: The farebox series is released to the board quarterly and to nobody else. The figures used here come from three board packets that were posted in error and later removed.

notes.label: Response rate
notes.body: Eleven percent, against a target of forty. The authority's own methods appendix calls a result at that rate indicative only.

notes.label: Weighting
notes.body: Weighting an eleven percent sample to the ridership frame would have implied a precision the sample cannot carry. Declining to weight it was the right call and it is why the survey cannot bear the argument built on it.

notes.text: closures had almost no effect at all
notes.label: The null version
notes.body: On this reading the decline is a fare and frequency story that began years before the closures and simply continued through them.
